description: This file defines the BookState class, which manages the state of a book reader application. It handles chapters, navigation, user preferences like font size and sidebar visibility, and interacts with content and annotation services for loading data and persisting preferences.

classes.name: BookState
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier class managing the state of the book reader, including chapters, navigation, preferences, and loading state.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Loads chapters and user preferences from services; initializes current chapter and section if not set.

methods.name: setCurrentChapter
methods.description: Changes the current chapter and optionally the section within it.

methods.name: setCurrentSection
methods.description: Sets the current section within the active chapter.

methods.name: nextChapter
methods.description: Advances to the next chapter if available.

methods.name: previousChapter
methods.description: Goes back to the previous chapter if available.

methods.name: setFontSize
methods.description: Updates the font size preference and persists it asynchronously.

methods.name: setShowNotesSidebar
methods.description: Toggles the visibility of the notes sidebar and persists the preference.
